blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) summoned a passenger bus operator on Tuesday after its driver allegedly disrespected a passenger. According to the LTFRB, it issued a show cause order (SCO) to Joyselle Express, requiring the operator to explain why its Certificate of Public Convenience should not be suspended or canceled over the incident.
